content: Generate a U-shaped profile by subtracting an offset rectangular box from a larger one, ensuring both ends remain open. The larger box should measure 450 mm in length, 70 mm in width, and 40 mm in height. Subtract an inner box that is 60 mm wide and 35 mm and high with same 450mm length, maintain a wall thickness of 5 mm around the sides and base, resulting in a U-shape, open at the top and sides | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the dimensions and positions for the U-shaped profile

# Outer box dimensions
outer_length = 450  # mm
outer_width = 70    # mm
outer_height = 40   # mm

# Inner box dimensions (subtracted)
inner_length = 450  # mm
inner_width = 60    # mm
inner_height = 35   # mm

# Wall thickness
wall_thickness = 5  # mm

# Calculate the position of the inner box to maintain wall thickness
# The inner box should be centered within the outer box
x_position = (outer_width - inner_width) / 2
y_position = wall_thickness  # 5 mm from the bottom
z_position = 0  # Same as outer box

# Output the calculated values
print(f"Outer box dimensions: {outer_length} x {outer_width} x {outer_height} mm")
print(f"Inner box dimensions: {inner_length} x {inner_width} x {inner_height} mm")
print(f"Inner box position: x={x_position}, y={y_position}, z={z_position} mm")"}
